commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Aleix Garcia (Girona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Giorgi Mamardashvili to dive and make a save.
90+2' Thierry Correia (Valencia) picks up a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
88' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) picks up an injury.
86' Sergi Canos (Valencia) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Paulo Gazzaniga.
84' 1 - 3 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Paulo Gazzaniga to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
84' Pepelu (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
83' Daley Blind (Girona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Valencia are awarded a penalty kick!
79' Substitution. Artem Dovbyk makes his way off the pitch and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
78' Portu (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul.
77' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' The attendance for today's match is 36138.
74' Michel prepares a substitution. Savio is replaced by Garcia Jastin (Girona).
74' Here's the change. Yangel Herrera leaves the pitch and Valery (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
73' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
72' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Jose Gaya and he is replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).

72' Diego Lopez (Valencia) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner.
71' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
68' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juanpe (Girona) replacing Eric Garcia.
68' That's the end of the game for Viktor Tsygankov, who is replaced by Portu (Girona).

64' A pass by Jose Gaya (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

57' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
54' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
53' A precise low pass is received by Sergi Canos (Valencia), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
52' Sergi Canos (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
48' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Hugo Duro (Valencia) is replaced by Peter Federico.
46' Here is a change. Dimitri Foulquier is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Thierry Correia (Valencia).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Savio (Girona) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
40' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and signals a foul after Daley Blind (Girona) brought his opponent down.
35' Sergi Canos (Valencia) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
32' 0 - 1 What a wonderful finish! Savio (Girona) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
31' Daley Blind (Girona) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is equal to it and makes an easy save.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
30' Savio (Girona) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
26' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) for his blatant foul.

25' Sergi Canos (Valencia) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the middle of the target as Paulo Gazzaniga produces a good save.

24' Eric Garcia (Girona) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post.
23' It seemed like Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
23' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
22' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' Aleix Garcia (Girona) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
17' The keeper makes a simple save after Javi Guerra (Valencia) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
15' Savio (Girona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
13' A pass by Arnau Martinez (Girona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
9' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
8' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle as Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' Ivan Martin (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
3' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
